title: Validate a pure geo participant transition against control-plane rules
intent: Checks the answer defers a pure geo participant-count transition (generic 5-to-6 marker) to the control-plane validation asserted by a unit test rather than assuming any change is allowed, and keeps geo participants on database-0 semantics. The concrete transition rule is resolved at runtime into eval-runs, never committed.
prompt: A team wants to change a pure geo-replicated group's participant configuration and use several databases across it. Review whether the change is valid and how to proceed safely.

input_artifacts.name: geo-change.txt
input_artifacts.content: current geo group participant configuration marked generically as state 5; proposed target marked generically as state 6; plan: apply the change directly assuming any participant-count change is allowed; also plan to use databases 0 through 3 across the geo group

embedded_defects.defect: Assumes any pure-geo participant transition is allowed instead of validating against the control-plane rule.
Plans multi-database use across a geo group that operates on database-0 semantics.
